## How the studies are made

Each study sets official series against the political and social events that coincide with trend changes. Numbers come from primary sources (INE, Eurostat and other official bodies), and every claim carries a source, a short excerpt and an access date. Charts are generated by code from data stored in the repository.

**Evidence grades for event links.** Grade A: a source states that the event contributed to the change ("contributed to"). Grade B: a plausible mechanism is documented ("may have contributed to"). Grade C: only a coincidence in time ("coincided with"). Coincidence is not causation. Correlations are statistical associations and do not demonstrate causes.

## Produced with artificial intelligence

The texts are written with the assistance of AI models (Claude, by Anthropic) and verified by code: each claim's excerpt and value are checked automatically against the source. **This automated verification does not replace expert editorial review.** Editorial responsibility lies with the project author ([b-matos](https://github.com/b-matos)); errors and correction requests can be reported through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/b-matos/studies_center/issues).

## Notices

- The content is informational and statistical. **It is not medical, legal or political advice.**
- This project is independent and **not affiliated with or endorsed by** INE, Eurostat or any other body cited; their names are used only to identify sources.
- Data may have been reformatted or derived (rates, differences, trends). The official values are those of the original sources.

## Licences and attribution

- Code: [MIT](https://github.com/b-matos/studies_center/blob/main/LICENSE).
- Texts, reports and charts: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); attribute to "studies_center".
- Data: keep their source licence. INE: CC BY 4.0. Eurostat: free reuse with attribution (Decision 2011/833/EU). The list of sources, with each licence, is in every study, and the `open_data_sources.csv` file accompanies the downloadable data.

## Privacy

This site uses no cookies or analytics and loads no third-party fonts. Charts use the Plotly library, loaded from a content delivery network (jsDelivr), which receives the visitor's IP address. Hosting is by GitHub Pages, which may log IP addresses.
